page0.text:
I dream of a box for breeding bugs.
A ruined nest.
Black pupa.
I have no memory of my birth.
I thrive and flourish.
My roots have always been unknown.
I have no memory of my death day.

page1.text:
I walk at a steady pace.
My empty head sways from side to side,
absent of any clear destination.
Shiver and tremble, go-go!
My dry hands and feet rattle like paper balloons,
tumbling along the ground.
I'll get to float once I grow up.
Go-go.
Go-go.
Go-go.
"Hey, check—out—you—rate that?"
Somebody squeaks as they come up to me.
"Oh, nice broad. —barefoot? Damn—
pale—"
People swarm up to me.
"—right? —join us—kill some time?"
Empty laughter.
I don't remember asking them to come.
They're scaring me. Time to go home.
"Hey—where—think—going?"
"Hold up—? You—bitc—!?"
"Don't you—? Why else—out—walk—town—?"
"Haha—ha! Yea—mean—we'd better—protect—right?"
"Totally, bro! —love helping—folks—trouble!"
"—ha—ha—ha—!"
"Ah—ha—hahaha—!"
"Ahahaha—hahaha—hahahahahahaha—"
"Ahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha!"
They keep chasing me.
Their screeching gives me a headache,
so my empty tummy rumbles.
"—!?!?!?"
"Wai—hold—wha—geee—!?"
"Eeek—don't run, asshole, help—eee!"
"Ha, ha, ha, what the, where'd you—
Geeeeeeeeeeegh!"
"N-no, s-sorry, I'm sorrrryyYYYYAARRGH!?!?!?"

page2.text: I dream of a box for breeding bugs.
